title: Importing Min, Max and a bin quantity for an untracked part saves them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test with Min 2 and Max 6 (saved while it was tracked) and 4 in bin location A.
  • Have a parts import file with one row for part A that sets bin location A's quantity to 9, Min to 3 and Max to 8.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (Settings, then Data Import, then Inventory).
custom_steps:
1. Upload the file.
  2. Run the import.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes with no error for part A's row: the row's number matches a part already stocked here, so the import updates part A and does not refuse it as a duplicate.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Part A still reads "Not Tracked".
  • Its Bin Location / Quantity shows bin location A with 9, and Min reads 3 and Max 8: the imported values were saved just as on a tracked part.

Step 6:

  • Part History has the entry "Min/Max updated | Min: 2 → 3 | Max: 6 → 8 | Source: Import".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S5-E1: “The parts CSV import can change Min, Max and bin quantities on an untracked part. The values are saved the same way as on a tracked part, and a Min or Max change is written to Part History (S10-R22a).”
  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
  • S10-R22a: “Changing Min or Max writes "Min/Max updated | {changes} | Source: {source}" to the part's Part History. {changes} is "Min: {old} → {new}" when only Min changed, "Max: {old} → {new}" when only Max changed, and both, Min first, joined by " | " when both changed. The source is "Edit Part" or "Import". No entry is written when neither value changed.”
